schema:alternativeHeadline:
Reverse of a mailed postcard contains a handwritten message, Brownsville postmark, green one-cent stamp and Wichita, Kansas recipient address.

Written text (transcribed as written):
Printed postcard: “THIS SPACE FOR WRITING MESSAGES. R-34130 POST CARD THIS SPACE FOR ADDRESS ONLY. C. T. PHOTOCHROM C. T. & CO. CHICAGO U.S. POSTAGE 1 CENT 1”
Postmark: “BROWNSVILLE, TEX. 4—P M JUN 20-16”
Handwritten message: “6-19-16 = This is quite interesting. Got a su[illegible]- pressed feeling exists and some thing liable to break out any time. Plenty of rumors about the other side of the River. It looks like Intervention soon. Hope to hear from you in a.m. Have written. H.R.L.”
Handwritten address: “Mr. H. F. Leslie Wichita Kans 721 Beacon”
